title: In-camera playback of 3840 x 2560 clips: the A7 IV's 8K decode channel (7690 x 4320, memory ids 0x47c / 0x47e)
status: built from the 6.01, 7.02 and 6.02 files; never read or written on an FX30. The FX3's same design (avdec8k_fx3_v1) is not run either; the A7 IV plays its own 3840 x 2560 clips with this channel
ported_from: avdec8k_fx3_v1 (FX3 7.02): the same bytes, the decode functions 0x1938 lower; A7 IV 6.02 allocation 0x20e3d8, row choice 0x20e788, table 0xbaceb0 row 3

code_sites.what: the id of the first decode-memory allocation (0x47d: 4K decode, 2 units of 152.3 MB in 0x6c4 -> 0x47c: 8K decode, the whole 536.2 MB of 0x6c4)
its copy for the failure log line (str w20, [sp, #8] at 0x2171c0)
the id of the second allocation (0x47f: 2 units of 38.6 MB -> 0x47e: 135.0 MB in 0x6dd)
its copy for the failure log line (str w21, [sp, #8] at 0x217234)

code_guard: the whole code page 0x217000-0x217fff apart from the four sites must be as in the file, in the mapping and in the kernel's own view (it holds the allocation 0x21714c, create-ch 0x21738c and its row choice 0x2174dc)

data_sites.what: decode size table row 0: width, height (the A7 IV's row 3)

apply: the four code words, each one aligned 32-bit store
data cache clean and instruction cache invalidate at each, all processors; isb
the row's size, one aligned 32-bit store
put_back: data cache clean and instruction cache invalidate at each; isb
order.why: a 4K row with the 8K memory is a smaller channel in larger memory (harmless); an 8K row with the 4K memory is not, so the row is changed only while the 8K ids are in place

icache.processors: 4 x Cortex-A35 (update/0800_appli/setting/cxd90057.dtb of the FX30 6.01); kernel 4.9.337 (vermagic 4.9.337-scel+ SMP, as the FX3)
icache.alias: the code page is mapped at a user address with the kernel's offset from a 2 MB boundary (0x17000), so a virtually indexed instruction cache is invalidated at the same index as the kernel's fetches
icache.refuse: an instruction cache that CTR_EL0 says is neither PIPT nor VIPT

checked.fx30_type_never_14: the FX30 caller 0x2286a8 makes types 11 / 12 / 13 / 10 (the FX3's 0x22a198); the A7 IV's 0x21f9c4 adds 14 for formats 0x26 / 0x27
checked.rows_equal: FX30 rows 0-2 = FX3 rows 0-2 = A7 IV rows 0-2; A7 IV row 3 = row 0 with 7690 x 4320
checked.allocator: FX30 0x22b8a4 = A7 IV 0x222bd0 (24 instructions, branch targets aside); arguments w1 0x61003c, w3 0x806800f3 the same
